description: Forbidden words in Alex-facing Russian text (Telegram reports, PR bodies, ticket summaries) with the replacement to use instead. Machine-readable twin of the Dictionary section in ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md. Rules are regexes over the WHOLE message (title + body); a rule with only_if_cyrillic applies only when the message contains Cyrillic text. Enforced by tg (refuses to send) and meant for any other agent-facing gate.

rules.replacement: починил / починен / патчил / чинится / будет починено / применён
rules.why: There is no verb 'почтить' meaning 'to fix'. Ban is by stem, not by a list of forms — three earlier list-based bans leaked new forms (почтил, почтётся).

rules.replacement: бенч / бенчмарк; a provider taken out of rotation: забенчен / в бенче / исключён из ротации / отключён на время
rules.why: 'bench' is never translated as a piece of furniture, not even figuratively.

rules.replacement: применяется / применён / влит / вливается / внедрён / вливание
rules.why: English 'land/landing' must not appear in Russian text about PRs, fixes or styles.

rules.replacement: применяется / применилась / применён / вступает в силу / влит
rules.why: Every form of сесть/садиться/лечь/ложиться/приземляться is banned for 'a change applies / a PR merges', in any context.
'пропсы' is wrong; the accepted form is 'пропы'.

rules.replacement: субагент / субагенты (or just describe the work)
rules.why: Dispatched subagents are an implementation detail; never say 'fork' to Alex.

rules.replacement: (drop it — never label your own tone)
rules.why: The tone is cynical; saying so is banned.

rules.pattern: you'?re absolutely right|great question|that'?s a great idea|great idea|excellent question
